content.comment_body: Hello, I enabled the web server on my [product_name] and can access it via my browser. However, when I try to set the Q1 variable to a value of 1 in the web interface, the output does not respond. If I activate the physical switch connected to I1, Q1 changes state properly, but this can't be done through the web server. Is there an additional setting I need to check?

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. Digital outputs can only be switched via the variable function if they are not being used within the program logic. To enable control from the web server interface alongside I1, you should add an OR or XOR logic block between I1 and the output. This will allow both web-based and physical input to operate Q1.

analysis.insight_summary: A user experienced difficulty controlling a digital output (Q1) through a web interface on [product_name], although hardware-based interaction works as expected. Community members clarified that outputs cannot be controlled from the web interface if the program logic is currently using them. Implementing parallel logic blocks (like OR/XOR) enables both program and web control, though this requirement may not be obvious.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipated seamless control of the Q1 output from the web interface, no matter its connection status or use in the program, and wished to avoid extra programming steps.
